pages.title: Katakan
pages.text: Predatory vampire: 80 HP, base damage 8, high speed.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Night surface or dark caves. Direct daytime sun without shelter or rain ignites it. No custom dungeons are added.

pages.title: Claws and bite
pages.text: Claws strike twice for 8. Bite deals 10 and heals 4 only on a successful hit. Charge prepares for half a second and stops at walls.

pages.title: Bat form
pages.text: Below 32 HP it uses a controlled bat form once in its lifetime, for up to 8 seconds. The bat has 8 HP and flees within 8 blocks; the original entity persists.

pages.title: Stop its healing
pages.text: During flight it heals 1 HP per second, up to 8 before returning. Kill the bat to stop healing and stun the returned Katakan for 12 ticks.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: Sunlight, vampire oil (20 percent, 30 hits), vampire elixir (25 percent, 180 seconds).

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Essence: 75 percent, 1–2. Claw: 40 percent. Head: 10 percent after a player/tamed kill. Vampire fang: 5 percent.

pages.title: Hunter advice
pages.text: Sidestep its charge. Pursue the bat and counterattack after killing it. An equipped Trinkets fang heals only from real hostile enemies.

pages.title: Unique equipment
pages.text: See $(l:hunter_equipment)Hunter Equipment$(/l) for the hammer and vampire fangs.
